description: Returns the paid x402 request that would store your value (POST /kv/put, $0.001 per call; schema linked); this call stores nothing, and a value is stored only if your own client pays that request. Use when an agent needs memory between runs without an account: store value (text or JSON, up to 8 KB) under key in a private namespace keyed to the wallet that pays. POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to store it. Bad input is refused before any charge. Overwrites an existing key; the key expires after ttl (60 s to 90 days, default 30 days) and there is no delete. Values are stored unencrypted: do not store secrets. Read back with kv_get or kv_list.

value.description: Text, or JSON stored as text (max 8 KB)
